question: Define $f: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ as $f(n) = \begin{cases} n/2, & \text{if }n\text{ is even}\\ 3n+1, &\text{if }n\text{ is odd} \end{cases}$. What is the value of $f(f(5))$?
explanation:
First evaluate $f(5)$. Since $5$ is odd, $f(5)=3\times5+1=16$.

Now evaluate $f(16)$. Since $16$ is even, $f(16)=16/2=8$.

Thus $f(f(5))=8$.
